{{Top}}
A '''transponder code''', also known as an '''identity beacon''',<ref name="Breaking">{{JournalCite|1|Breaking Free: The Adventures of Dannen Lifehold}}</ref> was a signal burned into the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]] that transmitted the ship's name, type, owner, and other pertinent data. For most of the galaxy's history, the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] issued and tracked transponder codes. 

==History==
In use since the beginning of spacefaring societies, transponder codes could be duplicated or removed, though the procedures involved were difficult, expensive, and highly illegal. Ships without transponder codes could not travel in civilized systems without attracting intense scrutiny.

[[Dannen Lifehold]]'s [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lifeline (YT-1300 light freighter)|Lifeline]]'' had an identity beacon that identified the vessel as the ''Black Knight''. The beacon was used aboard starships to broadcast their identities.<ref name="Breaking" />

Weapons such as [[FreiTek Incorporated/Legends|FreiTek's]] [[CL-3 antistarfighter cluster bomb]] actively scanned for enemy transponder codes in range to determine when to explode during combat.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
